```{python}
    end=[2, 5, 9]
)
epochs
```

::: {.column width="60%"}
```{python}
#| echo: false

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
fig, ax = plt.subplots(constrained_layout=True, figsize=(5,3))
for start, stop in epochs.values:
    ax.axvspan(start, stop)
ax.set_xlabel("time (s)")
plt.show()
```
